Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Resumption Of Operations At The Company'S Plant

analysis.summary: Bhagwati Autocast Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting growth in total income and profit before tax. Management noted that the company's profit was impacted by rising input and operating costs, but anticipates customer demand and growth of 20% to 25% in the next financial year. The company's renewable energy plants contributed nearly 40% of total power consumption, and the Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 3.50 per equity share. Bhagwati Autocast Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the fiscal year 2024-25, highlighting total income and profit before tax alongside management's expectation of a 15% to 20% growth in the next financial year.
